items.source: Recursively copy the contents of the src file/directory to the dest file/directory.
items.translation: 递归复制 `src` 文件/目录的内容到 `dest` 文件/目录。

items.source: IOException - in the case of I/O errors
items.translation: IOException - 在发生 I/O 错误的情况下

items.source: Note: Like File.delete(), this method does not throw any exception but rather silently returns false in case of I/O errors. Consider using deleteRecursively(Path) for NIO-style handling of I/O errors, clearly differentiating between non-existence and failure to delete an existing file.
items.translation: 注意：与File.delete()类似，此方法不会抛出任何异常，而是在发生 I/O 错误时静默返回false。建议使用deleteRecursively(Path)以 NIO 风格处理 I/O 错误，从而清晰区分文件不存在与删除现有文件失败的情况。

items.source: Delete the supplied Path — for directories, recursively delete any nested directories or files as well.
items.translation: 删除提供的 Path — 对于目录，递归删除任何嵌套的目录或文件。

items.source: true if the File was successfully deleted, otherwise false
items.translation: 如果成功删除了该 File，则返回 true；否则返回 false。

items.source: true if the Path existed and was deleted, or false if it did not exist
items.translation: 如果 `Path` 存在且已被删除，则返回 `true`；否则（即它不存在时）返回 `false`。

items.source: Delete the supplied File - for directories, recursively delete any nested directories or files as well.
items.translation: 删除提供的 File - 对于目录，递归删除任何嵌套的目录或文件。

items.source: Utility methods for working with the file system.
items.translation: 用于操作文件系统的实用方法。
